name: io.github.raydeoliveira/pdprobe
title: pdprobe
description: USB-C PD/PPS auditor, telemetry reader & trigger MCP server for Apple Silicon, KM003C, and FNB58.

environmentVariables.name: PDPROBE_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Polar.sh license key read by `pdprobe license activate` to unlock live `trigger_pd_pps` hardware writes (`dry_run: false`).

environmentVariables.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Optional base directory for `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/pdprobe/license.json` commercial license cache.

environmentVariables.name: PDPROBE_POLAR_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional Polar.sh API base URL override (HTTPS or loopback HTTP only) for license activation/deactivation.
